notes.title: ⭐It's Official, The Long-Awaited Sequel Is Coming This Month!⭐
notes.notes:
So it turns out that your time with Kira was only a glimpse into the secrets the island holds...

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282460][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8743936/ae9bf0154a1b15f840b15987fb035cb32a539016.jpg[/img][/url]
It's been a long time coming, but I'm thrilled to announce that we’re currently putting the final touches on our magical sequel! 🥹🪄
It's been over 10 years since I created Always The Same Blue Sky and hearing about the effect it's had on people still warms my heart, so thank you so much to everyone who's read it! 💖
In these past 10 years, I've worked hard to hone my skills and am excited to bring something far more ambitious to the table with Iridescence.

When you unexpectedly embark on an epic quest to help a mysterious girl from the sea find her way home, you quickly learn that there's so much more to the mysterious island where the worlds of the land and sea meet than you ever could have imagined...
This unforgettable adventure is brought to life with with gorgeous artwork and music, and is coming out very soon, so 🌟[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282460][b]add Iridescence to your wishlist now[/b][/url]🌟 to join Ayasal on a truly unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: Brand New Visual Novel Available Now!!
notes.notes:
Hey crew, I hope you all had a nice Christmas/New Year! :excitedstarfish:

[b]It's my pleasure to announce that my new visual novel, Entschuldigung (which means ‘sorry’ in German) is [u]now available[/u] on Steam!: [/b]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/570350][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8743936/ebf22dd3d26072ab7a969af75dd6d08f312f5bd1.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8743936/9c53fbbd7d079eb45458bd27919cbe70a4d635b0.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/570350]http://store.steampowered.com/app/570350[/url]

In between working on Always The Same Blue Sky and it's sequel [url=http://alwaysthesamebluesky2.com/]Iridescence[/url] I wanted to work on a story that was tonally very different. Entschuldigung is a bleak horror story, told by a lost young man who longs to find a place in which he can feel safe. Due to circumstances beyond his control, our protagonist has recently emigrated to Berlin; a town that brims with an undercurrent of anxiety as war rapidly approaches. Alone in an alien land, he diverts his attention to a mysterious, old house, adamant that it hides secrets in its shadows. An insatiable curiosity leads our protagonist down a very dark path into the murky depths of humanity. As he fights to comprehend his reality, he also fights to make sense of himself.

Please do check out the store page, and if horror isn't really your cup of tea, please tell any friends who don't mind their tea black. :determinedstarfish:
Your continued support means the world! =)

notes.title: Sequel Announcement + Spanish (Español) & Russian (Pусский) Translations Added
notes.notes:
That's right guys! Thanks to all of you, I've had the resources to work on a direct sequel. It's my great pleasure to officially announce '[b]Iridescence[/b]', coming Q4 2016! Make sure to bookmark [b][url=alwaysthesamebluesky2.com]alwaysthesamebluesky2.com[/url][/b] to follow our progress.

Always The Same Blue Sky was a small passion-project, which performed a lot better than I'd ever hoped, and I'm forever grateful for that. Because I now know that there's a market for it, I've been able to put a lot more into Iridescence, not to mention, all of us have grown significantly in both ourselves and our abilities over the past couple of years. I have also of course taken on board the feedback received from our debut release.
Iridesence keeps the same soul, but is a very different tale, focusing on grander themes... I'm really excited to give all of you more information, but for now that'll have to wait. I'll be unveiling bits and pieces over the coming months on [url=alwaysthesamebluesky2.com]alwaysthesamebluesky2.com[/url], as well as uploading exclusive artwork and desktop backgrounds, so make sure you check back regularly!

Patch Notes: 
[list]
    [*]Spanish translation added thanks to Angel Luis Caballero Cortés.
    [*]Russian translation added thanks to Rosinskiy Ivan (Vanya).
    [*]Preferences and save menu layouts updated.
    [*]End credits revamped.
[/list]

notes.title: Special Announcement Coming Soon + Updated Chinese Translation Now Live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I hope you're all well!
Just because you haven't heard from me in a little while doesn't mean I haven't been working hard... in fact, I've been working on something very special which I am planning announce shortly, so stay aboard!
I'd also like to take this opportunity to sincerely thank you all for your support. I'm very chuffed that Always has had over 100 reviews and is rated very positively. It's your support that has allowed me to continue producing visual novels, so like I said, stay tuned ;)
I'd also like to say a special thanks to fosr who has kindly updated the Chinese translation meaning that no matter what language you choose to play through in, all content is available to you.

Patch Notes:
The Chinese translation has been updated so that all features introduced in version 2.0 now function when playing through in Chinese. Please note that you will need to start a new game for this update to take effect - existing saves are not compatible. 
If you are not presented with the option to choose a gender when you first start a new game, then try the following: Return to the title screen, and go to 'Customise Journey'. Next change the language to English and then switch it back to Chinese. Finally, return to the title screen and select 'Start Journey'. Doing this will effectively clear any existing language data.

notes.title: Achievement Issues In Non-English Play-throughs
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Firstly, thank you all so much for your support! I'm really happy to hear that you're enjoying your time in the world we created.

I noticed that some of you not playing through in English are concerned that you haven't been unlocking achievements. As I said in the description, unfortunately features introduced since the release of version 2.0 are currently unavailable during non-English play-throughs, but I'm hoping to get updated translations out there soon, and will keep everyone updated in regards to this. That being said, I have released a small patch today that adds the achievements not dependant on the choices you make to non-English play-throughs.

If you have any other concerns, don't hesitate to drop me a message! =)

Thanks,
